Shut The Box rules:

At the start of the game all tiles are uncovered. Two dice are rolled and the corresponding tile or tiles are covered. The game ends if no tile could be covered on a throw of the dice. The final score is the sum of the numbers remaining uncovered at the end. The lowest score wins. Cover all tiles and you shut the box!

Shut the Box Thai style, always roll two dice, but only cover one tile matching one of the dice or their sum. For example, if the dice show a 2 and a 3 you may cover one of 2, 3 and 5.

Bunco rules:

There are six rounds in each set of Bunco. The bell signals the beginning and the end of each round. Players earn points by rolling three dice. In each round, players are trying to roll the same number as the number of the round (for example, rolling at least one 3 in Round 3). One point is awarded for each number rolled that matches the round number. A player continues rolling until no points are scored. The dice then pass to the computer (3 different AI options to choose from). The round is over when 21 points total is reached. Rolling three-of-a-kind of the same number of the round you're on is a BUNCO! It is worth 21 points! Rolling three-of-a-kind other than the number of the round you're on is worth 5 points. 

Score Card is presented at the end of each game. 

Tiebreakers: 

1) Most Wins (rounds) 
2) Most Buncos (total) 
3) Highest Score (total)

Double Domino rules:
